## Answer

**The error code E-2040 first appears at timestamp: `2026-10-11T00:62:32Z`**

## How I Obtained It

I used the Read tool to access the app.log file from the working directory (/tmp/tg-QD1gMp/work/app.log). The file contains log entries with timestamps, log levels, and error codes. By scanning through the log entries sequentially, I found that E-2040 first appears on line 53 of the file:

```
2026-10-11T00:62:32Z ERROR E-2040 request failed route=/api/orders latency=167ms
```

This is the first and only occurrence of the E-2040 error code in the log file. Other errors present in the file include E-1001, E-1002, and E-4212, but E-2040 appears for the first time at the timestamp shown above.
